## 8001 - 8005

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="08001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />8001 LCN - Location ready for close approval</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="08001">

This exception will only be generated when the Location is set for Close Approval. This is set in the Location Editor in Tools \> Info. If the option Requires Close Approval is checked, then this exception may be generated. This is generated by the Location Close Service. If the location meets the requirements to be closed (all meter and ticket data is closed), then the Location Close Service will generate this exception. The user can then go to the Close Approvals form to Approve their location for close.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="08002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />8002 LCN - Location close approved</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="08002">

This exception will only be generated when the Location is set for Close Approval. This is set in the Location Editor in Tools \> Info. If the option Requires Close Approval is checked, then this exception may be generated. After all meters are closed, the user will navigate to the Close Approvals form. A user will select their desired location for the desired month and then Approve the Close. When a user approves the close, it sets the location to closed for that month. This exception is informational in that it is generated when the Location is approved for close successfully.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="08004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />8004 LCN - Line fill volume exceeded</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="08004">

This exception is generated when the FC_FFLCN_HOURLY.raw_volume value exceeds the Line Fill Volume set in the Location Editor Characteristics. This data for this exception is most typically driven from Line Fill meter data. This can be accessed by choosing a location, and then going to the Characteristics tab. The user may then double click a record and set a Line Fill Volume. When FLOWCAL rolls up the meters in that location, if the sum of the meters exceeds the Line Fill Volume then this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### 8005 LCN - Unable to close location (data not finalized) (deprecated)

</div>
